The '''Xan sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Anic]], [[Katanos VII]], [[Trundalki IV]], and [[Xaza IV]].
